item.title: Kukie Serving.02 GPU Add-on Design
item.description: Why an external LLM API plan became a Helm add-on for users’ GPU clusters — quality and cost numbers behind the pivot, three layers split by required permissions, a chart with per-layer switches and a preflight job, the measurement-to-429 loop, an honest comparison with KubeAI and LiteLLM, and what is built versus still planned.
